[E] CanvasHistoryService / coordinated revisions
|-- DefaultCanvasHistoryService: owns history and its storage boundary
|   |-- private WeakMap<CanvasEditingContext, CanvasHistory>
|   |-- openContext -> new CanvasHistory -> frozen runtime handle
|   |   `-- handles isolate viewers; weak keys allow GC on close
|   |-- runtime handles/service stay outside saved canvases
|   |-- private history(context) rejects unknown handles
|   |-- state -> head checkpoint/document/view + undo/redo flags
|   |-- resolve -> history.diagrams.resolve(contextId, diagramId)
|   |-- document -> resolved document projection
|   |-- append -> history.append(document, view, correspondence)
|   |-- navigate -> reject linked transfer -> history.navigate
|   |-- reset / retireTransactions / adopt -> corresponding history methods
|   `-- exportContext / forkContext / persistenceChanges -> transport adapters
|       `-- callers do not interpret diagram revision tables
|-- MappingDocumentController retains its context handle
|   |-- recorded edits append; transient layout updates leave history head
|   |-- exportHistory/forkHistory/persistenceChanges delegate to service
|   `-- prepareTransferNavigation delegates both contexts + transaction
|-- CanvasWorkspace owns session replacement and disposal
|   `-- copyDocument -> clone view + forkHistory -> new CanvasSession
|       `-- clears selection/controls and pending conversation requests
|-- MappingPage coordinates transfer publication
|   |-- beginTransfer retains selected IDs + source checkpoint
|   |-- transfer checks retained checkpoint against current source head
|   |-- capture -> histories, document/view, camera, transaction list
|   |-- runWorkspaceTask(transfer): source/destination histories + input
|   |   `-- prepared states -> proposed workspace + transaction
|   |-- publishTransfer -> await storage.save -> installWorkspace
|   |   `-- installs both histories + transaction after acknowledgement
|   `-- undo/redo at transfer boundary
|       |-- checks participants and newer applied transfers
|       |-- prepareTransferNavigation -> proposed paired states
|       `-- publishTransfer; newly created destination hides on undo
|-- WorkspacePersistence: translates live owners into records
|   |-- owns per-session cursors, known drafts, subscriptions
|   |-- workspace.onPersist / view.subscribe -> sync / syncView
|   |-- controller.persistenceChanges(cursor) -> historyChanges
|   |   `-- delta.sequence advances session cursor
|   |-- emits metadata, baseline, history, canvas, viewport, index
|   |-- replacement deletes obsolete revision/checkpoint keys
|   |-- removed draft deletes its document-prefixed records
|   |-- captureDisplay/captureCamera sample SourcePaneViewState
|   `-- storage.batch(changes); pause during workspace transactions
|-- RecordStorage: owns record cache and write scheduling
|   |-- cache + pending map + one in-flight batch
|   |-- batch updates cache; schedule -> pump -> transport.write
|   |-- flight retains requestId, expectedRevision, changes, sequence
|   |-- acknowledgement advances persisted sequence + revision
|   |-- flush drains through its captured target sequence
|   `-- commit -> flush prior writes -> batch -> flush
|       |-- definitive REJECTED: restore cache; discard abandoned batch
|       `-- ambiguous failure: retry identical request/ID
`-- WorkspaceStorage: owns one worker per opened workspace
    |-- load -> worker request -> RecordStorage with write transport
    |-- save -> load + flush -> project(snapshot) -> records.commit
    |-- request map retains resolvers until reply/error
    |-- restore flushes/disposes records before reloading
    `-- dispose closes records, terminates worker, rejects pending requests
